findings.result: Both exact mapped radio inputs were acquired and matched to the official installed-build-family OTA, replacing mirror-only origin evidence.
findings.qualification: Source/payload match only. The physical board SKU and radio HCI/SDIO revisions remain unconfirmed.

findings.result: The mapped HCD contains 356 complete commands: 355 Write_RAM (0xfc4c), then Launch_RAM (0xfc4e). Pinned btbcm_patchram sends Download_Minidriver (0xfc2e) before parsing file commands. The absence of embedded 0xfc2e is therefore consistent with this consumer.
findings.qualification: Packet bounds only; no firmware was sent to a controller. btbcm UART subversion 0x610c selects BCM4354, but actual controller subversion is unknown.

findings.result: All 32 targeted linux-firmware payload paths match installed ALARM bytes at upstream commitab23307cfe7f9366c819025ca3e4778299bc2db2: BCM4354 SDIO binary and CLM, original Tegra210 XUSB, VIC, 15 GM20B paths and 13 RTL8168 family candidates.
findings.qualification: GM20B sw_method_init is a documented upstream symlink to the GM200 file; inactive staging stores its resolved bytes. No complete GPU execution/signature or radio functional test occurred.

findings.result: Stock currentOTA XUSB version_id 0x50260003 differs from modern linux-firmware 0x50290003. Stock VIC is 15,616 bytes; upstream/L4T 32.2.1 VIC is 16,640 bytes and those two are byte-identical. Current OTA NVDEC/NVENC also differ from older L4T 32.2.1 candidates.
findings.qualification: Keep each version and its provenance distinct. Firmware version freshness alone does not establish driver or command ABI compatibility.

findings.result: Pinned ACK requests nvidia/tegra210/nvdec.bin and nvenc.bin. Current OTA and older L4T NVDEC/NVENC candidates pass Falcon-v1 framing but use vendor filenames and have not been qualified for this driver command ABI.
findings.qualification: Switchroot FFmpeg pin 65445e23ebc92e6f5e333065e93eb705cb67aac8 uses /dev/nvhost-nvdec, /dev/nvhost-msenc and libnvbuf_utils.so.1.0.0 NvBuffer APIs. ACK Tegra DRM/host1x is a different userspace contract. Renaming firmware cannot bridge this gap.

findings.result: The complete targeted stock firmware directory was harvested: 49 regular files totaling 8,637,795 bytes, including radio, GM20B, video, JPEG, TSEC, audio DSP and peripheral firmware. The unified OTA also contains Foster, B01 and BCM4356 inputs; these remain distinct donor references.
findings.qualification: Additional stock audio/peripheral binaries were inventoried only; neither their Linux consumer support nor their applicability to the owner board is established.

findings.result: Original linux-firmware notices/WHENCE, L4T NVIDIA/Cypress notices and the stock OTA NOTICE.xml.gz are retained locally. All public artifacts are metadata only.
findings.qualification: SHA256/Git blob identity/ZIP CRC are integrity records, not independent authenticity or redistribution permission. Whole OTA signature was not verified from these partial members; the bundled certificate is not an independent trust anchor.

gaps: Independently confirm actual Darcy board SKU/revision before activating A00-to-A08 NVRAM mapping; the label P2897 is not an exact board revision.
Read actual SDIO chip/revision and Bluetooth HCI subversion on a native diagnostic boot; validate exact firmware load and radio operation.
Preserve a unique owner MAC. The publicly sourced NVRAM contains a MAC field; validate the mainline platform-MAC override path before deployment and never publish calibration contents or MAC values.
Establish redistribution rights for stock OTA/vendor-mirror firmware before packaging or releasing those payloads. The retained general OTA NOTICE is not an identified firmware license.

Validate upstream BCM4354 SDIO binary/CLM with the exact Darcy NVRAM, regulatory domain and runtime driver before selecting them for the port. Stock DHD binary/CLM stay a separate matched vendor reference.
Resolve NVDEC/NVENC command and userspace ABI compatibility; test VIC operations separately. Parser success cannot pass video hardware acceptance.
Check RTL8168 PCI revision to select the actual firmware member from the 13 family candidates; no exact Ethernet revision is currently claimed.
Verify GM20B secure firmware loading, power management, EGL/OpenGL and display buffer sharing on physical hardware; upstream file availability is not GPU support qualification.
Retain B01 XUSB and BCM4356 PCIe radio inputs separately; never substitute them for original Tegra210 / SDIO BCM4354.
Integrate a reviewed per-board fetch/package lock and stricter hardware audit in a later coherent change. This harvest does not modify the tested runtime recipes, lockfiles or packages.
